bio_en: Margar Jamharian, called Mrav, was a native of Shushi with a bold and rebellious character from his school days, when a teacher predicted he would die on the gallows. He devoted himself to the ARF's cause and, in the Armenian-Tatar clashes of 1905, fought to save his birthplace from destruction. He was killed by Tatar bullets during the defence of Shushi in 1905, and Droshak mourned him in November of that year.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium.
